title: 36 Hours in Silicon Valley
abstract: The area south of San Francisco buzzes with cultural spaces, lively restaurants and a hyper-educated workforce that has no problem keeping up.

title: 36 Hours in Charleston, S.C.
abstract: This graceful Southern city has new restaurants, shops and transformed neighborhoods to discover.

title: 36 Hours in Rio de Janeiro
abstract: With the World Cup coming in 2014, and the Olympic Games in 2016, Rio is building museums, reviving old neighborhoods and opening cafes.

title: 36 Hours in Chicago
abstract: Chicago has been on the rise recently, adding parks, architectural crowd pleasers and public art to its already considerable offerings.
